import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# --- Data Preparation ---

# Filter for the most recent complete year to get a current snapshot
latest_year = df['StichtagDatJahr'].max()
df_latest = df[df['StichtagDatJahr'] == latest_year].copy()

# Clean breed names: standardize capitalization and strip whitespace
# Also, handle potential mixed-language entries like 'Franz. Bulldogge' -> 'Französische Bulldogge'
df_latest['Rasse1Text'] = df_latest['Rasse1Text'].str.strip().str.title()
df_latest['Rasse1Text'] = df_latest['Rasse1Text'].replace('Franz. Bulldogge', 'Französische Bulldogge')


# Drop rows with missing breed or age information
df_latest.dropna(subset=['Rasse1Text', 'AlterVHundNum'], inplace=True)

# Identify the top 12 most popular breeds
top_breeds_counts = df_latest['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(12)
top_breeds = top_breeds_counts.index

# Filter the dataframe to include only the top breeds
df_top = df_latest[df_latest['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Calculate median age for sorting the breeds on the y-axis
median_ages = df_top.groupby('Rasse1Text')['AlterVHundNum'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
sorted_breeds = median_ages.index

# --- Visualization ---

# Set plot style and create figure
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create the raincloud plot effect: half-violin and stripplot
# 1. Violin Plot (for density)
sns.violinplot(
    data=df_top,
    y='Rasse1Text',
    x='AlterVHundNum',
    order=sorted_breeds,
    palette='viridis',
    inner=None, # No inner plot elements
    ax=ax,
    cut=0 # Don't extend density past data
)
# Make violins half-violins
for collection in ax.collections:
    path = collection.get_paths()[0]
    vertices = path.vertices
    vertices[:, 1] = np.clip(vertices[:, 1], -np.inf, ax.get_yticks().tolist().index(np.median(vertices[:, 1])))
    collection.set_paths([path])


# 2. Box Plot (for summary statistics)
sns.boxplot(
    data=df_top,
    y='Rasse1Text',
    x='AlterVHundNum',
    order=sorted_breeds,
    width=0.2,
    boxprops={'zorder': 2, 'facecolor': 'white'},
    medianprops={'color':'red', 'linewidth':2},
    whiskerprops={'linewidth':2},
    capprops={'linewidth':2},
    ax=ax
)

# --- Final Touches ---
# Add breed counts as annotations
for i, breed in enumerate(sorted_breeds):
    count = top_breeds_counts[breed]
    ax.text(ax.get_xlim()[1] * 1.01, i, f'n={count}', va='center', ha='left', fontsize=11, color='gray')


# Set titles and labels
title_text = f'Age Distribution of the 12 Most Popular Dog Breeds in Zurich ({latest_year})'
subtitle_text = 'Breeds are ordered by median age (red line). Violins show the density distribution.'
fig.suptitle(title_text, fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
ax.set_title(subtitle_text, fontsize=14, pad=20, loc='left')

ax.set_xlabel("Dog's Age (Years)", fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel("Breed", fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)

ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=12)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=12)

# Adjust plot limits and grid
ax.set_xlim(left=-1)
ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
sns.despine(left=True, bottom=True)

# Adjust layout to make space for annotations
plt.subplots_adjust(right=0.9)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
